updates.title: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: FTP and SFTP Support
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP now monitors and protects sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols from managed endpoints. Security admins can configure restrictive actions in Endpoint DLP policies to prevent unauthorized data exfiltration across these file transfer methods.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention Expansion to Microsoft Cowork
updates.summary: Purview DLP policies now extend to Microsoft Cowork, allowing admins to apply consistent data security controls across AI interactions by blocking sensitive knowledge sources, restricting sensitive prompts, and preventing Bing web search integration for protected data. This unifies DLP enforcement for both Copilot and Cowork within a single policy framework.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Inline Protection for Unmanaged AI Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP policies will support inline protection across a significantly broader set of unmanaged generative AI applications within Edge for Business. Admins can detect and protect sensitive data shared through browser activities using existing policy experiences, extending consistent data security controls to more destinations.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention: Restrict External Email Processing in Copilot
updates.summary: Purview DLP will expand to block Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing emails originating from senders external to your organization. This real-time control helps mitigate data risks by preventing sensitive information in external emails from being exposed to generative AI processing.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Version Trimming for Retained Files
updates.summary: Compliance admins will be able to enable version trimming for OneDrive and SharePoint files covered by retention policies, reducing storage bloat while maintaining legal-hold and records compliance promises. This policy-scoped setting allows SharePoint's version management to trim retained file versions when enabled, helping large regulated enterprises reclaim storage.

updates.title: Information Protection: Auto-labeling for Legacy Office File Formats
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview server-side auto-labeling will support legacy Office formats (.doc, .xls, .ppt), enabling organizations to automatically evaluate and apply sensitivity labels to these older files in SharePoint and OneDrive. This extends labeling coverage to environments still managing legacy file formats.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management: Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes (Main and Auxiliary) will become accessible through Microsoft Graph API, providing users a unified Archive view even when data spans multiple auxiliary mailboxes. This transition prepares organizations for the October 2026 deprecation of EWS Graph APIs.
